fit: oral ground C.verum and motor proxies after acute MPTP in mice
assessment: Ground cinnamon 100 mg/kg/day began three hours after MPTP for seven days. Figure 8 (six mice/group) favors powder for rotarod and rearing/grooming in Gfap-cre littermates. Rotarod genotype-by-treatment p=.021 supports the reported GDNF dependence; rearing/grooming interactions were inconclusive. Early post-insult motor evidence supports limited favorable transfer, not clinical gait velocity. Separate benzoate arms and cell experiments are not patient comparisons.
